content.short: Large scale, Play at your own pace, competitive board game on Cardano!
content.description:
Enjoy loads of fun while becoming the richest player through buying, renting, collecting, and selling property. 750 game pieces, 25 leaderboard winners ranked by the player's total amount of Cardopoly Dollars.

We connect other Cardano Communities to bring multi-policy fun and allow other projects on the blockchain to join in on the gamified experience using their NFT's are featured game pieces on our board! Providing competitive gaming utility to the Cardano ecosystem since 2022!
